title: GET /v1/orgs/{org}/attention/summary response
description: Body of a successful response to GET /v1/orgs/{org}/attention/summary (03-api.md section 4.6, KOR-39): counts over the readable workgroups; done_since counts done records with since at or after the parameter; open_working, open_waiting and open_no_agent are the overview of the open tasks (every task that is not closed in exactly one of them).

open_working.description: open tasks an agent works on (category working)

open_waiting.description: open tasks waiting for a person's answer, approval or decision (category needs_decision)

open_no_agent.description: open tasks no agent works on and nobody is asked about (category blocked, and done except done/closed)
